fn rs_field_info(stage: *RsStage, syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax, name: *RmdName,
                 location: *RmdLoc) -> *RmdField {
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdField); }
    if (*syntax).kind != RMD_T_NAME {
        rs_error(stage, location, "field access requires a record");
        return null(*RmdField);
    }
    var global: *RsGlobal = rs_global(stage, (*syntax).name);
    if global == null(*RsGlobal) || (*(*global).source).kind != RMD_D_RECORD {
        rs_error(stage, location, "field access requires a declared record");
        return null(*RmdField);
    }
    var field: *RmdField = (*(*global).source).fields;
    while field != null(*RmdField) {
        if (*field).name == name { return field; }
        field = (*field).next;
    }
    rs_error(stage, location, "record has no such field");
    return null(*RmdField);
}

fn rs_place_access(function: *RsFunction, value: *RsValue, write: bool,
                   location: *RmdLoc) -> unit {
    if (*value).local != null(*RsLocal) {
        rs_access(function, (*value).local, write, location);
    } else {
        if write && (*value).mode == RS_READ {
            rs_error((*function).stage, location, "cannot write a constant place");
        }
    }
}

fn rs_place_base(function: *RsFunction, source: *RmdExpr,
                 output: *RsStatements) -> *RsValue {
    var stage: *RsStage = (*function).stage;
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    while (*source).kind == RMD_E_GROUP { source = (*source).left; }
    var kind: u32 = (*source).kind;
    if kind == RMD_E_NAME || kind == RMD_E_FIELD || kind == RMD_E_INDEX ||
       (kind == RMD_E_UNARY && (*source).op == RMD_OP_DEREF) {
        return rs_place(function, source, output, false, false);
    }
    var value: *RsValue = rs_expr(function, source, output);
    if (*stage).failed || value == null(*RsValue) { return null(*RsValue); }
    if (*(*value).syntax).kind == RS_READ || (*(*value).syntax).kind == RS_MUT {
        var place: *RsValue = rs_value(function, (*(*value).syntax).base,
            rs_unary(stage, RMD_OP_DEREF, (*value).expression, &(*source).loc));
        if place != null(*RsValue) {
            (*place).local = (*value).local;
            (*place).mode = (*(*value).syntax).kind;
            rs_place_access(function, place, false, &(*source).loc);
        }
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
        return place;
    }
    return value;
}

fn rs_place_pointer(function: *RsFunction, value: *RsValue, output: *RsStatements,
                     location: *RmdLoc) -> *RsValue {
    var stage: *RsStage = (*function).stage;
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    if (*function).unsafe_depth == 0usize {
        rs_error(stage, location, "raw pointer access requires unsafe");
        return null(*RsValue);
    }
    var copy: *RsValue = rs_value(function, (*value).syntax, (*value).expression);
    if copy == null(*RsValue) { return null(*RsValue); }
    var captured: *RsValue = rs_capture(function, output, copy, location);
    if (*stage).failed || captured == null(*RsValue) { return null(*RsValue); }
    var place: *RsValue = rs_value(function, (*(*value).syntax).base,
        rs_unary(stage, RMD_OP_DEREF, (*captured).expression, location));
    if place != null(*RsValue) {
        (*place).local = (*value).local;
        if (*value).local != null(*RsLocal) { (*place).mode = (*value).mode; }
    }
    return place;
}

fn rs_place_inner(function: *RsFunction, source: *RmdExpr, output: *RsStatements,
                  write: bool, initialize: bool) -> *RsValue {
    var stage: *RsStage = (*function).stage;
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    var kind: u32 = (*source).kind;
    var location: *RmdLoc = &(*source).loc;
    if kind == RMD_E_GROUP { return rs_place(function, (*source).left, output, write, initialize); }
    if kind == RMD_E_NAME {
        var local: *RsLocal = rmd_map_get(&(*function).locals, (*source).name as usize) as *RsLocal;
        if local != null(*RsLocal) {
            if initialize && write && !(*local).initialized && (*local).mode == 0u32 {
                if (*local).exclusive || (*local).readers != 0usize {
                    rs_error(stage, location, "initialization conflicts with an active borrow");
                }
            } else { rs_access(function, local, write, location); }
            if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
            var value: *RsValue = rs_value(function, (*local).syntax,
                rs_place_local(function, local, location));
            if value != null(*RsValue) {
                (*value).local = local;
                (*value).mode = (*local).mode;
            }
            return value;
        }
        var global: *RsGlobal = rs_global(stage, (*source).name);
        if global == null(*RsGlobal) || (*(*global).source).kind != RMD_D_CONST {
            rs_error(stage, location, "place requires a visible local or constant");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        if write {
            rs_error(stage, location, "cannot write a constant place");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        var value: *RsValue = rs_value(function, (*global).syntax,
            rs_named(stage, (*(*global).lowered).name, location));
        if value != null(*RsValue) { (*value).mode = RS_READ; }
        return value;
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_FIELD {
        var base: *RsValue = rs_place_base(function, (*source).left, output);
        if (*stage).failed || base == null(*RsValue) { return null(*RsValue); }
        if (*(*base).syntax).kind == RMD_T_POINTER {
            base = rs_place_pointer(function, base, output, location);
            if (*stage).failed || base == null(*RsValue) { return null(*RsValue); }
        }
        var field: *RmdField = rs_field_info(stage, (*base).syntax, (*source).field_name, location);
        if (*stage).failed || field == null(*RmdField) { return null(*RsValue); }
        var record_global: *RsGlobal = rs_global(stage, (*(*base).syntax).name);
        if (*record_global).resource != null(*RsResource) && (*function).unsafe_depth == 0usize {
            rs_error(stage, location, "resource fields require unsafe access");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        rs_place_access(function, base, write, location);
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
        var expression: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, RMD_E_FIELD, location);
        if expression == null(*RmdExpr) { return null(*RsValue); }
        (*expression).left = (*base).expression;
        (*expression).field_name = (*field).name;
        var value: *RsValue = rs_value(function, (*field).syntax_type, expression);
        if value != null(*RsValue) {
            (*value).local = (*base).local;
            (*value).mode = (*base).mode;
        }
        return value;
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_INDEX {
        var base: *RsValue = rs_place_base(function, (*source).left, output);
        if (*stage).failed || base == null(*RsValue) { return null(*RsValue); }
        var base_kind: u32 = (*(*base).syntax).kind;
        if base_kind != RMD_T_ARRAY && base_kind != RMD_T_POINTER {
            rs_error(stage, location, "indexing requires an array or raw pointer");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        var syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax = (*(*base).syntax).base;
        var count: u64 = (*(*base).syntax).count;
        if base_kind == RMD_T_POINTER {
            var pointed: *RsValue = rs_place_pointer(function, base, output, location);
            if (*stage).failed || pointed == null(*RsValue) { return null(*RsValue); }
            (*base).expression = (*(*pointed).expression).left;
            (*base).mode = (*pointed).mode;
        }
        var index: *RsValue = rs_expr(function, (*source).right, output);
        if (*stage).failed || index == null(*RsValue) { return null(*RsValue); }
        if (*(*index).syntax).kind != RMD_T_USIZE {
            rs_error(stage, &(*(*source).right).loc, "array and pointer indexes require usize");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        rs_place_access(function, base, write, location);
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
        if base_kind == RMD_T_ARRAY {
            var upper: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, RMD_E_INTEGER, location);
            var condition: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, RMD_E_BINARY, location);
            var guard: *RmdStmt = rs_stmt_node(stage, RMD_S_IF, location);
            var body: *RmdStmt = rs_stmt_node(stage, RMD_S_BLOCK, location);
            var failure: *RmdStmt = rs_stmt_node(stage, RMD_S_TRAP, location);
            if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
            (*upper).literal_type = RMD_T_USIZE;
            (*upper).integer = count;
            (*condition).op = RMD_OP_GE;
            (*condition).left = rs_clone_expr(stage, (*index).expression);
            (*condition).right = upper;
            (*guard).expr = condition;
            (*guard).body = body;
            (*body).body = failure;
            rs_append(output, guard);
        }
        var expression: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, RMD_E_INDEX, location);
        if expression == null(*RmdExpr) { return null(*RsValue); }
        (*expression).left = (*base).expression;
        (*expression).right = (*index).expression;
        var value: *RsValue = rs_value(function, syntax, expression);
        if value != null(*RsValue) {
            (*value).local = (*base).local;
            (*value).mode = (*base).mode;
        }
        return value;
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_UNARY && (*source).op == RMD_OP_DEREF {
        var operand: *RsValue = rs_expr(function, (*source).left, output);
        if (*stage).failed || operand == null(*RsValue) { return null(*RsValue); }
        var operand_kind: u32 = (*(*operand).syntax).kind;
        if operand_kind != RMD_T_POINTER && operand_kind != RS_READ && operand_kind != RS_MUT {
            rs_error(stage, location, "dereference requires a pointer or borrowed view");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        if operand_kind == RMD_T_POINTER && (*function).unsafe_depth == 0usize {
            rs_error(stage, location, "raw pointer access requires unsafe");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        var value: *RsValue = rs_value(function, (*(*operand).syntax).base,
            rs_unary(stage, RMD_OP_DEREF, (*operand).expression, location));
        if value == null(*RsValue) { return null(*RsValue); }
        (*value).local = (*operand).local;
        if operand_kind == RS_READ || operand_kind == RS_MUT { (*value).mode = operand_kind; }
        rs_place_access(function, value, write, location);
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
        return value;
    }
    rs_error(stage, location, "expression is not an assignable place");
    return null(*RsValue);
}

fn rs_place(function: *RsFunction, source: *RmdExpr, output: *RsStatements,
             write: bool, initialize: bool) -> *RsValue {
    var stage: *RsStage = (*function).stage;
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    if (*function).expression_depth >= 256u32 {
        rs_error(stage, &(*source).loc, "resource expression nesting exceeds 256");
        return null(*RsValue);
    }
    (*function).expression_depth = (*function).expression_depth + 1u32;
    var result: *RsValue = rs_place_inner(function, source, output, write, initialize);
    (*function).expression_depth = (*function).expression_depth - 1u32;
    return result;
}
